description: This file contains client-side scripting for the Work Order doctype in ERPNext, including form setup, event handlers, custom button actions, and UI logic for manufacturing workflows.

classes.name: Work Order
classes.description: Client-side script for managing the Work Order form, including setup, refresh, and custom actions.

classes.name: Work Order Item
classes.description: Client-side script for handling interactions within the Work Order Items table, such as fetching item details.

classes.name: Work Order Operation
classes.description: Client-side script for managing operations within the Work Order, including workstation and time inputs.

methods.name: set_custom_buttons
methods.description: Sets custom action buttons based on the current status of the work order.

methods.name: calculate_cost
methods.description: Calculates planned operating cost based on operations.

methods.name: calculate_total_cost
methods.description: Calculates total operating cost including additional costs.

methods.name: set_default_warehouse
methods.description: Sets default warehouses if not already set.

methods.name: get_max_transferable_qty
methods.description: Returns maximum quantity transferable based on current work order state.

methods.name: show_prompt_for_qty_input
methods.description: Prompts user to input quantity for transfer or creation actions.

methods.name: make_se
methods.description: Creates a stock entry for manufacturing or material transfer purpose.

methods.name: create_pick_list
methods.description: Creates a pick list for material transfer.

methods.name: make_consumption_se
methods.description: Creates a stock entry for material consumption.

methods.name: change_work_order_status
methods.description: Updates the status of the work order (Close, Stop, Re-open).

methods.name: show_progress_for_items
methods.description: Displays progress bars for items produced and in progress.

methods.name: show_progress_for_operations
methods.description: Displays progress bars for operations based on their status.

methods.name: production_item
methods.description: Fetches and updates details for the selected production item.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Triggers production item update when project changes.

methods.name: bom_no
methods.description: Fetches items and operations from selected BOM.

methods.name: use_multi_level_bom
methods.description: Handles toggling of multi-level BOM usage.

methods.name: qty
methods.description: Triggers BOM fetch when quantity changes.

methods.name: before_submit
methods.description: Sets required fields before submitting the work order.

methods.name: set_sales_order
methods.description: Filters sales orders based on production item.

methods.name: additional_operating_cost
methods.description: Recalculates total costs when additional costs are updated.
